name: eutl-installation-net-short
description: At the close of compliance year t-1's surrender cycle (30 April of year t), will a stationary EU ETS installation's verified emissions for year t exceed the free allocation it holds for year t (a net-short year), given its verified-emissions and free-allocation history through t-1, its already-published year-t allocation, its registry and its identifier?
license: Union Registry public extracts: Commission reuse policy CC BY 4.0 (source terms preserved; attribution 'European Commission, DG CLIMA - Union Registry public extracts'). Derived research dataset - not the Commission's official product. Our derived compilation: CC0-1.0.

split.strategy: temporal by compliance year (30 April surrender deadline of year t)

label_rule: net_short = 1 iff VERIFIED_EMISSIONS(t) > ALLOCATION(t); exact ties are 0 and counted. Both label source values are excluded from every shipped file.
prediction_time: 30 April of compliance year t, the surrender deadline that closes year t-1's compliance cycle: by then the installation's verified emissions for t-1 (reported by 31 March) and its surrendered allowances for t-1 are settled in the Union Registry, and its year-t free allocation is already fixed and published (the extract carries allocation rows through 2030, measured). Year t's verified emissions are reported by 31 March t+1 and are absent from the registry at the instant (measured: no numeric verified emissions for years after 2025 in the daily extract). The extract refreshes daily, so a monthly refresh of this task is honest.
